document.abstract: Digital Video Broadcasting (DVB) has been shaping the future of television for over 25 years, but we have no intention of resting on our laurels! We are committed to continuing our mission, both to strengthen broadcasting and to specify the transition to seamless hybrid broadcast-broadband services and delivery. DVB remains focused on providing the best technical solutions for all market needs and following the latest technology trends. This approach has served us well, resulting in a future-proof ecosystem that continues to evolve.
